# INVESTMENT MEMORANDUM

## 1. Executive Summary

**Date of Agreement:** 2020-12-28

**Borrower / Company Overview:** 
Oaktree Specialty Lending Corporation, a Delaware corporation, is the borrower under this incremental commitment agreement. The company has subsidiary guarantors including OCSL SRNE, LLC (a Delaware limited liability company) and FSFC Holdings, Inc. (a Delaware corporation).

**Transaction Description:**
This is an incremental commitment agreement that increases an existing senior secured revolving credit facility. The transaction involves MUFG Union Bank, N.A. as the increasing lender, providing additional commitment capacity under the amended and restated senior secured revolving credit agreement originally dated February 25, 2019. ING Capital LLC serves as administrative agent and issuing bank.

**Purpose of Financing:**
The document does not explicitly state the specific purpose for this incremental commitment increase.

**Company Background:**
Limited company background information is provided in the document. The borrower operates under an existing senior secured revolving credit facility with multiple lenders including ING Capital LLC, JPMorgan Chase Bank N.A., and Bank of America N.A. serving in various agent and syndication roles.

• Senior secured structure with established credit facility framework
• Multiple subsidiary guarantors providing additional credit support
